sections.body: Some things FLOAT on water. Some things SINK to the bottom. 💧
A leaf and a plastic duck float. 🦆🍃 A stone and a coin sink. 🪨🪙
We can also sort things: hard or soft, hot or cold.
With a grown-up, fill a bowl with water. Guess first: float or sink? Then test!
Always supervise water play. Ask 'What do you think will happen?' before each test. Guessing first is real science!

quiz.q: What happens to a stone in water?
hints: Does it stay on top or go to the bottom?
A coin 🪙 sinks to the bottom of a bowl. A stone does the same.
quiz.explain: A stone sinks to the bottom!

hints: Soft things squish when you press them.
Which one would you lay your head on?
A teddy bear 🧸 is soft. Find another soft thing.
quiz.explain: A pillow is soft and squishy!
